output.reason: Sudden thunderclap headache described as the worst of her life one hour ago with new neck stiffness requires immediate emergency imaging to exclude subarachnoid hemorrhage.
output.patientMessage: Call 911 now. A sudden "worst headache of my life" that peaked instantly, now with neck stiffness, can mean bleeding around the brain and needs emergency imaging right away — do not drive yourself or wait for a reply. If you become drowsy, confused, weak, numb, or start vomiting or seizing while waiting, tell the dispatcher immediately.
differential: Meningitis or other secondary thunderclap cause (e.g. dissection, RCVS)

redFlags.concern: Thunderclap headache, worst of life, maximal at onset
redFlags.quote: the worst headache of my life, totally out of nowhere... It hit like a thunderclap
My neck feels a bit stiff now too
